Broad angular matte painted facets and restrained hand-painted cracks, dark forest-teal recesses, rich muted turquoise planes and a few brighter turquoise edge chips. No symbols, text, glyphs, numbers, arrows, spark, fire, gems, scenery, baked labels, sheen or glow. Original painted material, not a screenshot and not cropped reference art.
